description: React component for user security settings in Mattermost, including password management, sign-in methods, OAuth applications, MFA, and session management.

classes.name: SecurityTab
classes.description: React component class managing user security settings including password, MFA, OAuth apps, sign-in methods, and session management.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to load OAuth apps if enabled.

methods.name: loadAuthorizedOAuthApps
methods.description: Fetches authorized OAuth applications for the user.

methods.name: isPasswordValid
methods.description: Validates the new password according to password policy.

methods.name: updateCurrentPassword
methods.description: Updates current password state from input.

methods.name: updateNewPassword
methods.description: Updates new password state from input.

methods.name: updateConfirmPassword
methods.description: Updates confirm password state from input.

methods.name: handleUpdateSection
methods.description: Handles section change in the security settings UI.

methods.name: createPasswordSection
methods.description: Renders the password management UI section.

methods.name: createSignInSection
methods.description: Renders the sign-in method management UI section.

methods.name: createOAuthAppsSection
methods.description: Renders the OAuth applications management UI section.
